integrity: The cyclic face family is identified with the quotient of the standard triangular tessellation by (a,b) with a+3b divisible by n. The exact hexagonal word norm classifies all length-four nonzero classes and proves both successive independent lengths symbolically; bounded graph computations corroborate the claimed carrier census.
scientific_limitations: Combinatorial edge lengths only, for T_{n,1,3} with n>=17. The first systolic shell is completely classified; only the length, not all carriers, of the second independent minimum is determined. No optimization over different triangulations or smooth flat-torus metrics is claimed.
title: A one-direction systolic shell in the cyclic torus family \(T_{n,1,3}\)
